### Bio:

I am a Master’s student in the Department of Biostatistics at UCLA and received my B.S. in Statistics from UC Davis in 2024. My academic interests include early cancer screening and diagnostic testing, missing data methodologies, and evaluating the health and equity impacts of social policies. My hobbies include exploring different cafes in the city, hiking, and hanging out with my orange cat, Kekoa!
